articles.title: Cabinet Approves Expansion of Deep Ocean Mission to Boost Blue Economy
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved Phase-II of the Deep Ocean Mission focusing on deep-sea mining technology and marine biodiversity conservation.
prelims: Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
Key Component: Development of MATSYA 6000, a human submersible capable of reaching 6,000 meters depth.
Focus Area: Polymetallic nodules containing copper, nickel, cobalt, and manganese in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
articles.mains: Examine the significance of the Deep Ocean Mission in securing critical mineral supply chains and enhancing India's strategic footprint in the Indian Ocean Region.

articles.title: Election Commission Introduces Enhanced Digital Voter Verification System
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India has launched an AI-driven digital verification platform to streamline electoral roll management across states.
prelims: Constitutional Basis: Article 324 grants powers of superintendence, direction, and control of elections to ECI.
Governed by the Representation of the People Act, 1950 for electoral roll preparation.
Key Feature: Automated cross-referencing to eliminate duplicate and deceased entries across interstate databases.
articles.mains: Discuss how digital technologies can enhance electoral integrity while addressing privacy concerns and risks of digital exclusion.

articles.title: India and European Union Finalize Green Hydrogen Trade Standards
articles.summary: India and the EU have established harmonized certification and trade standards for Green Hydrogen to accelerate bilateral clean energy trade.
prelims: National Green Hydrogen Mission aims for 5 MMT annual production capacity by 2030.
Definition: Green Hydrogen is produced through electrolysis of water using renewable energy sources.
Harmonized standards align with the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) requirements.
articles.mains: Evaluate the role of international green energy partnerships in achieving India's Panchamrit climate goals and boosting energy exports.

articles.title: RBI Issues Updated Framework for Climate Risk and Sustainable Finance
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has mandated climate scenario stress testing and green asset disclosure for major financial institutions.
prelims: Applies to Scheduled Commercial Banks, All India Financial Institutions, and Deposit-taking NBFCs.
Framework relies on guidelines from the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS).
Mandates structured reporting on physical and transition risks associated with institutional loan portfolios.
articles.mains: Analyze how climate-related financial risks threaten banking stability and suggest policy measures to scale green finance in India.

articles.title: Archaeological Survey of India Unearths Megalithic Site in Vidarbha
articles.summary: Excavations in Maharashtra's Vidarbha region have uncovered Iron Age megalithic stone circles containing iron tools and black-and-red ware.
prelims: Megaliths are large stone structures used as burial sites or commemorative markers.
Vidarbha region is renowned for major Iron Age megalithic sites such as Mahurjhari, Junapani, and Naikund.
Key findings include horse trappings, iron weaponry, and characteristic Black and Red Ware (BRW) pottery.
articles.mains: Discuss the socio-economic and technological significance of Megalithic cultures in understanding early iron age transitions in Peninsular India.
